description: This file defines the VtigerActorOperation class, which manages CRUD operations and metadata for Vtiger actors in the CRM web services. It extends WebserviceEntityOperation and interacts with database tables to perform create, retrieve, update, delete, and describe functions specific to actor entities in the system.

classes.name: VtigerActorOperation
classes.description: Class providing CRUD and metadata operations for actor entities in Vtiger CRM via web services.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the actor operation object with dependencies and obtaining entity table name.

methods.name: getMetaInstance
methods.description: Returns cached or new instance of the entity metadata.

methods.name: getActorTables
methods.description: Retrieves the database table name associated with the actor entity, with caching.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns the metadata object for the entity.

methods.name: getNextId
methods.description: Generates a new unique ID for an entity, updating sequence table if necessary.

methods.name: __create
methods.description: Performs the raw insert operation to create a new actor record.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Sanitizes input and calls __create, then retrieves the created record.

methods.name: restrictFields
methods.description: Filters input data to include only module fields, optionally only selected fields.

methods.name: __retrieve
methods.description: Performs the raw select operation to retrieve actor data by ID.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves an actor record by ID, handling exceptions if not found.

methods.name: __update
methods.description: Performs the raw update operation on the database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Sanitizes input, updates record, and returns updated data.

methods.name: __revise
methods.description: Performs an update expecting the record to exist, used by revise method.

methods.name: revise
methods.description: Retrieves existing record, overlays provided data, updates, and returns updated.

methods.name: __delete
methods.description: Performs the raw delete operation in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a record by ID and returns success status.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Returns metadata description of the actor entity, including permissions and fields.

methods.name: getModuleFields
methods.description: Returns metadata fields for the module, caching after first call.

methods.name: getDescribeFieldArray
methods.description: Provides field description array for a given webservice field.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a raw SQL query parsed from the input string, returning sanitized results.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Returns the current element data stored in the object.
